messages:
Ivy (Docs): Quick heads up: I opened PR #8510 — fixes broken example snippet and a couple of internal links. Netlify preview exists but the RST example block is rendering as plain text.
Ravi (DevEx): Saw that. The preview HTML includes triple backticks instead of a fenced code block markup MkDocs expects for rst -> try `:::python` style or ensure the markdown extension is enabled.
Jordan (Eng): Which parser are we using? CommonMark or PyMdown? The mkdocs config used to enable `pymdownx.superfences` for advanced fences.
Ivy (Docs): mkdocs.yml on the branch shows `markdown_extensions: [toc, admonition]` only. That would explain it. I added a commit enabling `pymdownx.superfences`.
Netlify Bot: Deploy preview queued for branch `pr/8510`.
Ivy (Docs): Also noticed linkcheck fails intermittently in CI for the internal `/sdk/python/` links. They resolve locally when running `mkdocs build` but the CI uses `LINKCHECK_TIMEOUT=10`. Might be a timing flake.
Ravi (DevEx): For CI parity use `CI=true make docs-test` which runs mkdocs in build mode. I'll bump linkcheck timeout in the pipeline to 30s for this run.
Jordan (Eng): Can reviewers please prioritize? This touches migration guide examples and the python SDK snippet used by customers. We should merge before the scheduled docs release at 19:00 PT.
Ivy (Docs): Tagging reviewers: @Jordan, @Ravi. PT merge window after 18:30 would be ideal to allow post-merge staging verification.
Ravi (DevEx): Re-deployed preview: https://deploy-preview-8510--redwood-docs.netlify.app 10. Images fine, and code block now highlighted.
CI Bot: Docs linting step failed on one trailing whitespace in `sdk/python/README.md` 11.
Ivy (Docs): Fixed whitespace and pushed. Also added a short note in PR description with local repro: `git fetch origin pull/8510/head:pr/8510 && git checkout pr/8510 && pip install -r docs/requirements.txt && mkdocs build -f docs/mkdocs.yml && python -m http.server --directory site 8000` 12.
Jordan (Eng): Quick review done. A tiny wording nit in the migration guide (prefer "client" vs "sdk client"). Approving after that tweak.
Ravi (DevEx): FYI, Netlify sometimes rewrites absolute paths if `use_directory_urls` differs between branches. If you see `/index.html` links in preview, set `use_directory_urls: false` in mkdocs.yml on the branch.
Ivy (Docs): Noted. Will merge at 18:45 PT and monitor the staging deploy. If linkcheck flakes post-merge I'll revert the link changes and open a follow-up.
Netlify Bot: Deploy preview for PR merged. Staging build started for branch `main`.
Ivy (Docs): Thanks everyone. If you want to test the production-like preview locally use `CI=true LINKCHECK_TIMEOUT=30 make docs-build` so you run the same steps as pipeline. Ping here if anything breaks and I'll follow up immediately :pray:
